# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Brierley school  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, gloomy face with black eyes. He is described as a clever and unusual boy who appears as though he could be fairly pleasant if his sullen exterior were penetrated.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony is a self-reliant and stubborn boy who forms his own opinions. He exhibits insolent and cheeky behavior, often displaying a sullen and disdainful attitude toward authority. Despite his oppositional nature, he respects physical discipline and straightforward toughness over gentle treatment.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- Insolent  <sub>[v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030)</sub>
- Self-reliant  <sub>[v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- Clever academically  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## History

Anthony Tulk came to live with his aunt, Mrs. Laurence Tulk, and began attending Brierley school under the instruction of Nell Harcourt. From the beginning, he displayed disdain for female teachers and resisted Nell's attempts to win his affection, engaging in minor acts of misbehavior such as pouring water down a classmate's neck and putting a live mouse in Nell's desk drawer. After the mouse incident, Nell lost her temper and gave him a sharp whipping with a wooden pointer. Contrary to Nell's fears that she had permanently alienated him, the punishment earned Anthony's respect, causing him to offer to carry her books the following day and declare that her beating was 'just as good as a man's.' Upon learning later of Nell's resignation from teaching, Anthony vented his emotions by deliberately starting two fights with other schoolboys.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
